scenes.bubble: A year‑end rebate is just a discount. No VAT effect.
scenes.caption: Year‑end rebates and returns.
scenes.say: Myth or fact? Year-end rebates and returns don't affect your V.A.T.
cap: Year‑end *rebates* and *returns* don't affect your VAT.

scenes.head: Output VAT, adjusted
scenes.src: Federal Decree‑Law No. 8 of 2017 on VAT, Arts. 61 and 70 (uaelegislation.gov.ae); checked 29 Oct 2026. Illustrative example, not a real company.
scenes.say: Fact: under the V.A.T. law, if the price is reduced, a supply is cancelled or goods come back, output tax is adjusted and a tax credit note is issued.
cap: Fact: if the price is *reduced*, a supply is *cancelled* or goods come *back*, output VAT is adjusted and a *tax credit note* is issued.

scenes.say: So match each credit note to its original invoice, and record it in the right tax period.
cap: So match each credit note to its *original invoice*, and record it in the *right tax period*.

scenes.disc: General information only, not legal or tax advice. Illustrative example, not a real company.
scenes.say: Our V.A.T. advisory reviews these adjustments with you. Questions on your next return? Talk to us.
cap: Our VAT advisory reviews these adjustments with you.
